title: Substring Concatenation of All Words

monster.name: Lexicon Behemoth
monster.title: Devourer of Word Tiles
monster.defeatQuote: Fixed-word-length chunking mapped all concatenated indices!

description: You are given a string `s` and an array of strings `words` of the same length. Return an array of all the starting indices of substring(s) in `s` that is a concatenation of each word in `words` exactly once and without any intervening characters.
starterCode:
def findSubstringWords(s: str, words: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def findSubstringWords(s: str, words: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    if not s or not words: return []
    from collections import Counter
    w_len = len(words[0])
    total_len = len(words) * w_len
    word_count = Counter(words)
    res = []
    for i in range(len(s) - total_len + 1):
        sub = s[i:i + total_len]
        chunks = [sub[j:j + w_len] for j in range(0, total_len, w_len)]
        if Counter(chunks) == word_count:
            res.append(i)
    return res
hints: Since all words have the same length L, split every window of size len(words)*L into chunks of size L.
